intro: I have taught across undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in media studies, communication, and digital culture. My teaching is informed by my research interests in technology, gender, and society, and draws on a range of interdisciplinary perspectives.
philosophy: I approach teaching as a collaborative intellectual endeavour — one that encourages students to engage critically with contemporary questions about media, power, and technology. I aim to create inclusive, discussion-led learning environments that value diverse perspectives and forms of knowledge.

courses.title: Media, Technology and Society
courses.description: An introduction to the social shaping of technology, platform economies, and the governance of digital media.

courses.title: Gender and Digital Culture
courses.description: Explores intersections of gender, identity, and digital life, including online harassment, algorithmic bias, and feminist approaches to technology.

supervision: I welcome enquiries from prospective postgraduate students working on topics related to media policy, digital governance, AI and society, and gender and technology. Please get in touch by email before making a formal application.
